topic: Why allowance teaches spending but a hustle teaches earning
caption:
Allowance runs out. Earning skills don't.

When your teen learns to make money instead of just receive it, something shifts — they start thinking like a problem solver, not a consumer.

HustleUp gives them a real framework to earn $50, $100, even $200 a month through side hustles built for their age and schedule.
